title: Variables & Types
explanation: A variable is a labelled box holding one value. Java insists on knowing the type up front: int for whole numbers, double for decimals, boolean for true or false, and String for text.
Declare one as: type name = value; After that the name stands in for the value everywhere you use it.
The + operator glues text together. Swap gold_block for another block id - diamond_block, sea_lantern, tnt - and run it again.
